Historian Rebecca Lemov joins Joe Rogan for episode 2322 to talk about mind control. Lemov studies the history of brainwashing claims and the science used to back them. Her work runs from Cold War labs to cults and interrogation rooms.

Lemov traces how brainwashing became a household fear during the Cold War. She describes real experiments on sleep, drugs, and isolation, and how courts and media used the idea. Rogan asks what actually works and what is myth. The episode gives a careful history of a word people still throw around loosely today.
